div.div: 2 سمّجهُ , (A, O, L, Msb, K,) inf. n. تَسْمِيجٌ, (O, K,) He, or it, rendered it foul, unseemly, or ugly; (O, Msb, * K;) or devoid of beauty. (L, Msb.) One says, مَا سَمَّجَهُ عِنْدِى إِلَّا كَذَا [Nothing rendered it foul, unseemly, &c., in my estimation, but such a thing]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
